verification.summary: Confirmed PR #80 merge and clean-main post-merge evidence, two remaining active legacy stat consumers, the existing structured transport and race-safe workbench state, and the explicit no-backend/no-Catalyst boundary.

229 tests passed. Covered the exact canonical body, 202 to 200 polling in both consumers, 15-attempt and 45-second caps, 409/503/offline truth, stale suppression, last-verified read-only display, strict cache binding and legacy-template fail-closed behavior.
394 frontend tests passed across 124 commands, including syntax, owner-map, project-state and Harness checks.
394 Node tests plus 1326 Python tests passed with one existing skip across 130 commands; compileall, JSON parsing, syntax, Harness and diff checks passed.

verification.summary: No backend, schema, worker, public payload, deployment or Catalyst source changed. Review tightened total timeout budgeting, stale-response invalidation, current-vs-stale rendering and request/server signature persistence before verification.

risks.detail: Pure state caps requests at 15 and total time at 45 seconds, including bounded retry delay and per-request timeout; focused and full tests pass.
Request serial plus canonical context identity reject old completions; equipment clear and SimC selection changes invalidate in-flight state while preserving only the prior read-only snapshot.
Both consumers use requestWebsimGearStatSnapshot and the same begin/apply/timeout state contract; active source has no requestWebsimGearStats call site.
The implementation diff is limited to four frontend modules and their tests; full verification proves backend, PG, worker, public and Catalyst characterization remains green.
